description: This Java class implements a serializer for JWT tokens, converting various Java objects into JSON strings and handling serialization exceptions. It supports serialization of primitives, collections, maps, and date types, and is designed for use with the JJWT library framework.

classes.name: JjwtSerializer
classes.description: A final class implementing a Serializer interface to convert Java objects into JSON byte arrays for JWT processing.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the serializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a Java object to a JSON byte array, throwing SerializationException on failure.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts an input object into a JsonValue using heuristics for various types.

methods.name: toJsonObject
methods.description: Transforms a Map into a JsonObject by mapping entries to JSON fields.

methods.name: toJsonArray
methods.description: Transforms a Collection or array into a JsonArray.
